name: Ente Photos
description: Ente is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted platform to store, share, and rediscover your photos and videos across all your devices.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Ente db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Ente jwt secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  museum:
    image: ghcr.io/ente/server:latest@sha256:4dba9930b25f6595d17cb28c41c299a6238b803f0244f9027703436fb4fa8aff
    container_name: ente-museum
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_started
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      ENTE_DB_HOST: postgres
      ENTE_DB_PORT: "5432"
      ENTE_DB_NAME: ente_db
      ENTE_DB_USER: pguser
      ENTE_DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_ENTE_DB_PASSWORD}
      ENTE_DB_SSLMODE: disable
      ENTE_S3_ARE_LOCAL_BUCKETS: "true"
      ENTE_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE_URLS: "true"
      ENTE_S3_B2_EU_CEN_KEY: ente-minio-access
      ENTE_S3_B2_EU_CEN_SECRET: change-me-minio-vH3pL8xC0zN5
      ENTE_S3_B2_EU_CEN_ENDPOINT: localhost:3200
      ENTE_S3_B2_EU_CEN_REGION: eu-central-2
      ENTE_S3_B2_EU_CEN_BUCKET: b2-eu-cen
      ENTE_KEY_ENCRYPTION: yvmG/RnzKrbCb9L3mgsmoxXr9H7i2Z4qlbT0mL3ln4w=
      ENTE_KEY_HASH: KXYiG07wC7GIgvCSdg+WmyWdXDAn6XKYJtp/wkEU7x573+byBRAYtpTP0wwvi8i/4l37uicX1dVTUzwH3sLZyw==
      ENTE_JWT_SECRET: ${SECRET_ENTE_JWT_SECRET}
      ENTE_APPS_PUBLIC_ALBUMS: http://localhost:3002
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - ente_network
  socat:
    image: alpine/socat@sha256:603174b77eebaba25ba8f8ebb15e1234d6600409554e95d6fb203fd106150287
    container_name: ente-socat
    network_mode: service:museum
    depends_on:
      - museum
      - minio
    command: TCP6-LISTEN:3200,fork,reuseaddr,ipv6only=0 TCP:minio:3200
    restart: unless-stopped
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/ente/web:latest@sha256:b59f681175405a769325ff542a6f4420e9cf8fbd5c538ea9812a75fcc004e056
    container_name: ente-web
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
      - "3002:3002"
    depends_on:
      - museum
    environment:
      ENTE_API_ORIGIN: http://localhost:8080
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - ente_network
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15@sha256:bcab099bfaab33333a73a2ebe8c1d615c9f4c2402dd43452f989a36c6da9a5ba
    container_name: ente-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: pguser
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_ENTE_DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ente_db
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U pguser -d ente_db"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - ente_network
  minio:
    image: minio/minio@sha256:14cea493d9a34af32f524e538b8346cf79f3321eff8e708c1e2960462bd8936e
    container_name: ente-minio
    ports:
      - "3200:3200"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ente-minio-access
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: change-me-minio-vH3pL8xC0zN5
    command: server /data --address ":3200" --console-address ":3201"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/minio_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - ente_network
  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc@sha256:a7fe349ef4bd8521fb8497f55c6042871b2ae640607cf99d9bede5e9bdf11727
    container_name: ente-minio-init
    depends_on:
      - minio
    entrypoint: >
      /bin/sh -c " until mc alias set ente http://minio:3200 ente-minio-access change-me-minio-vH3pL8xC0zN5; do sleep 1; done; mc mb --ignore-existing ente/b2-eu-cen; mc mb --ignore-existing ente/wasabi-eu-central-2-v3; mc mb --ignore-existing ente/scw-eu-fr-v3; exit 0; "

    networks:
      - ente_network
networks:
  ente_network:
    driver: bridge
